everyone.title: Transfer a call to a colleague
everyone.text: The agent can hand a caller over to a colleague on the route's list.

everyone.title: Automatic language detection
everyone.text: Calls and dictation find the language from the first words and answer in it.

everyone.title: Upload a whole folder
everyone.text: Drop a folder into the chat or the workspace. Every file in it uploads.

everyone.title: Claude Haiku 5.5
everyone.text: The fastest Claude model, now on Claude Code and Direct LLM.

everyone.title: Call you from the chat
everyone.text: An agent that finds something in your chat can call you about it, knowing everything in that chat.

admins.title: Back up and restore by script
admins.text: One script backs up the whole install. Another one restores it.

admins.title: See the version and new releases
admins.text: Setup shows the running version and tells you when a new release is out.

admins.title: Ask for a PIN on outbound calls
admins.text: A route can ask the person who answers for a PIN before the agent speaks.
